authoritySpine.description: On discharge from probation where judgment was deferred, the court's criminal record with reference to the deferred judgment is expunged, together with dismissed counts in the same charging instrument and other related dismissed charges arising from the same transaction or occurrence or a common scheme or plan. The record is not expunged until the financial obligations in that case are paid.

authoritySpine.description: Recorded in the track authority. Read by the source review as the provision under which the deferred judgment itself remains on the state court administrator's deferred judgment docket and is not expunged.
The provision under which judgment is deferred. Revocation of the deferred judgment makes the case ineligible under chapter 907.

Confidentiality provision. An expunged criminal court record is confidential and exempt from public access under § 22.7 and is not accessible except by court order. This is the required framing for what the relief does.

mechanism: On discharge from probation where judgment was deferred under § 907.3, the court's criminal record with reference to the deferred judgment shall be expunged, together with dismissed counts in the same charging instrument and other related dismissed charges arising from the same transaction or occurrence or a common scheme or plan. The record is not expunged until financial obligations in that case are paid. The deferred judgment itself remains on the state court administrator's deferred judgment docket and is not expunged. This mechanism sits outside Rules 2.80 through 2.86 and has no Rule 2.86 form.

screeningKeys.question: In which Iowa county was the case?
Was the outcome a deferred judgment, rather than a conviction or a dismissal?
Have you been discharged from probation, and on what date?
Was the deferred judgment ever revoked?
Have you paid every financial obligation in the case that contains the deferred judgment?
Does the case still appear on the Iowa public online docket?
Was your discharge from probation before July 1, 2013?

units.legalUnit: Verify that the automatic expungement happened, and diagnose it if it did not. For a discharge after July 1, 2013 there is no participant filing: the expungement is expected to occur without an application. The product is diagnostic — confirm the disposition was a deferred judgment rather than a conviction or a dismissal, confirm discharge and its date, confirm every financial obligation in that case is paid, check whether the case still appears on the public online docket, and if it does, contact the clerk of the district court for that county.

omissionProof.statement: units[] enumerates every legal unit that the pinned registry entry and the IA state pack record for ia-9079, and adds no unit either source does not record. It is a one-to-one mapping of registry tracks[126].units[0..1]: ia-9079-post-2013-verification (order 1, outputStrategy process_guidance, resolved, available) and ia-9079-pre-2013-application (order 2, outputStrategyStatus unresolved, available false). The remaining entries in packetSet.participantActionRequired are participant acts against unit 1 rather than separate legal units and are carried inside the guidance component and participant-instructions.md: obtain_document (ask the clerk for the balance in the case), confirm_answer (check the financial-obligations answer against the clerk's confirmation), sign ("No participant signature on the diagnostic branch"), pay_fee ("No fee identified. The diagnostic route is free"), apply_fee_waiver ("Not applicable"), serve_party ("No service on the diagnostic branch. There is no petition to serve"), and file (no participant filing on the available branch). registry manualCompletionItems and postGenerationHandoffs are both empty, so no unit is drawn from them. No agency_request_letter unit is created: the registry describes the clerk contact as contacting the clerk and asking for the balance, and records no written request document; drafting one would invent a mechanism the source does not state.

A full-value scan of the profile for "907.9", "907.4", "907.3" and "deferred judgment" returned no other hit bearing on this track's units, and the profile contains no pathway, question, caseOutcomeOption, ordered decision rule, waiting-period rule, exclusion rule, or packetGenerator pathway for ia-9079. The compiled profile therefore records zero legal units for this track, and the enumeration above cannot be a subset of it. It is a complete image of the registry's own units[].

counselFlags.statement: The deferred judgment itself remains on the state court administrator's deferred judgment docket and is not expunged. That docket is how courts and prosecutors know a deferred judgment was used, and it feeds the § 901C.3 two-deferred-judgment limitation. The participant must be told this; describing the outcome as a clean slate would be wrong.
